implBoundaryMap::new.signature: pub fn new( from_degree: Degree, to_degree: Degree, matrix: BasicMatrix<Q>, ) -> Result<Self, HomologicalError>
implBoundaryMap::new.body: { super::exact_scalar::admit_matrix(&matrix)?; let expected = from_degree .checked_pred() .map_err(|_| HomologicalError::DegreeOverflow)?; if to_degree != expected { return Err(HomologicalError::DegreeMismatch { expected: expected.value(), got: to_degree.value(), }); } let map_hash = hash_matrix(&matrix); Ok(Self { from_degree, to_degree, matrix, map_hash, }) }
implBoundaryMap::new.obligation: Admit canonical matrix coefficients before degree work, then checked i32 predecessor/successor, exact target equality and deterministic matrix fingerprint. Preserve the owned fields; neither a whole-complex zero-square law nor a basis-family binding is checked here.

implBoundaryMap::apply.signature: pub fn apply(&self, chain: &Chain) -> Result<Chain, HomologicalError>
implBoundaryMap::apply.body: { if chain.degree != self.from_degree { return Err(HomologicalError::DegreeMismatch { expected: self.from_degree.value(), got: chain.degree.value(), }); } if chain.coefficients.len() != self.matrix.cols() { return Err(HomologicalError::DimensionMismatch { expected: self.matrix.cols(), got: chain.coefficients.len(), }); } let result = self .matrix .mul_vec(&chain.coefficients) .map_err(HomologicalError::MatrixError)?; Ok(Chain::from_canonical( self.to_degree, chain.basis_id.clone(), result, )) }
implBoundaryMap::apply.obligation: Reject source-degree mismatch before coordinate-length mismatch. Canonical admitted matrix and vector feed checked BasicMatrix::mul_vec. Its reserve/index errors remain MatrixError; exact row-major Q dot sums produce canonical output. The internal canonical producer moves that same result with the stored target degree and caller family label; no redundant output admission scan remains.

implBoundaryMap::from_degree.obligation: Copy the exact stored source degree.

implBoundaryMap::to_degree.obligation: Copy the exact stored target degree.

implBoundaryMap::matrix.obligation: Borrow the same immutable admitted matrix; no public mutation or unvalidated wire constructor.

implBoundaryMap::source_dim.obligation: Read matrix column count, including rectangular and zero-area shapes.

implBoundaryMap::target_dim.obligation: Read matrix row count, including rectangular and zero-area shapes.

implBoundaryMap::hash.obligation: Recompute the matrix-only fingerprint. It does not bind degree or family metadata; different valid degrees on one matrix intentionally have the same hash.
